005cfaf4386c265f.name: play_knockdown_kick
005cfaf4386c265f.doc: State machine keyed on the saved value 300: plays Max's knockdown kick motion (a kick at a downed enemy), then clears the saved value and waits 3 frames.

02e4adf97ad563b1.name: run_player_action_loop
02e4adf97ad563b1.doc: Main loop. A press of the confirm button starts the charge attack (state 100) when idle, and otherwise it runs the carry-move for walking.

0383b9a6ac9e333a.name: on_init
0383b9a6ac9e333a.doc: Registers the col_ha monster attack hit area and sets the move speed to 3.4.

03c11994c24a9dcb.name: run_gun_aim_and_fire
03c11994c24a9dcb.doc: Handles the sub weapon gun, states 800 and 801. While the aim button is held Max aims, pressing attack fires a shot at 30 to 40 percent of the fire motion and returns to aiming.

040a77793e4b2c0c.name: setup_attack_hits_for_form
040a77793e4b2c0c.doc: Registers attack hit windows depending on which monster form (224, 228, 232, 236, 240) the player has transformed into, and prints the form id.

06167898735f8f58.name: run_sword_combo_state
06167898735f8f58.doc: Runs the five-hit sword combo (states 100 to 104): pushes Monica forward during each swing and chains to the next swing when attack is pressed in its window. Holding attack for over 10 frames in the first swing switches to the charge attack state 1200.

06c026bebf9c693d.name: run_player_input_loop
06c026bebf9c693d.doc: Main per-frame loop for Max in a dungeon. It reads the pad and picks the action from the saved value: sword combo, mid-range lunge, knockdown strike, charge attack, backflip dodge, sub-weapon shot, guard and catch, item throw, or lift and throw. When idle it runs stick movement.

09e765ad5b86007f.name: on_damage
09e765ad5b86007f.doc: Cancels guard, knocks the character back, releases anything held, plays the damage motion for 8 frames and clears the action state.

107f05442685cc2f.name: on_stopped
107f05442685cc2f.doc: Cancels guard, knocks back lightly and plays the damage motion until the stun status clears.

132a9bd27c25af7b.name: react_to_damage
132a9bd27c25af7b.doc: Meant to knock the character back (speed 5.0), drop what it holds, play the damage motion, wait 8 frames and return to idle. Under this disc's numbering the knockback runs play_chara_se with a bad bank, so nothing plays, the drop and motion calls run other natives, and the state reset is an _EXT_ call that does nothing.

136a325df49d5ef8.name: run_charge_attack_state
136a325df49d5ef8.doc: Monica's charge attack, driven by the saved value 1200 to 1202. Holds the charge loop (flash at 20 frames), releases into the charge attack with brief invincibility once the button is let go, then shoves the character forward and shakes the camera until the motion ends.

16b8f05222c519e0.name: wait_until_motion_done
16b8f05222c519e0.doc: Waits each frame until the current motion has finished, then returns 1.

1786cb290a3362bc.name: play_knocked_flying_reaction
1786cb290a3362bc.doc: Player reaction to a heavy hit: knocked back, turns to the blow source, drops anything held, plays the flying and get-up motions, then clears the saved value.

17e64e2b0cbf02cc.name: run_max_charge_attack
17e64e2b0cbf02cc.doc: Max's charge attack state machine, keyed on the saved value 1200 to 1202. While charging it loops the charge motion with slow movement and flashes at 20 held frames; letting go before then cancels to state 0. Once charged, releasing the button plays the charge attack with 30 frames of invincibility and the charge effect, pushes him forward from 20 to 47 percent of the motion, and returns to state 0 when it ends. Returns 0.

1909311fb243df6d.name: on_init
1909311fb243df6d.doc: Registers Monica's sword attack hit windows, body collisions, blade trails and footstep sounds, and resets the charge effect handle and power.

19228028f87eb529.name: run_lift_and_throw
19228028f87eb529.doc: Lift and throw state (1100 and up): lifts and grabs a target in front, carries it while moving, and on Confirm plays the throw motion and releases it.

1a5df26998c33fc2.name: fire_weapon_long_burst
1a5df26998c33fc2.doc: Plays the weapon wind-up, fires the ridepod weapon every frame for 30 frames, then plays the wind-down motion.

1e5ad002609557e7.name: setup_monster_attack_hit
1e5ad002609557e7.doc: Registers the monster attack hit collision (dcol00) with the attack 1 motion.

1ef8c0aa7960ccd2.name: lunge_in_mid_range_attack
1ef8c0aa7960ccd2.doc: Max's mid-range attack state (saved values 200 and 201): plays the attack motion once, lunges Max forward between 30 and 40 percent of the motion, then clears the saved value and waits 6 frames when the motion ends.

2467bdcc9f8b27b4.name: do_back_flip_dodge
2467bdcc9f8b27b4.doc: Plays a back flip with 20 frames of invincibility, pushing backwards while the flip is mid-motion, then clears the saved action value.

24b0feb8f479c9ef.name: run_guard_lift_throw_action
24b0feb8f479c9ef.doc: State machine on the saved value (900 to 904): guard, then lift on the action button, carry with stick movement, and throw on a second press, releasing the held object 30 percent into the throw motion.

25605de22b2f41ef.name: run_guard_and_throw
25605de22b2f41ef.doc: States 900 to 904: guard in, guard loop, lift, carry and throw. Holding the guard loop and pressing the lift input picks the target up, and the throw plays on the later states.

268def241924d741.name: run_gun_aim_and_fire
268def241924d741.doc: State 800 aims the gun while L1 is held and fires on the action button, and state 801 plays the shot and fires the gun projectile partway through. Returns to aiming when the shot motion ends, and drops to idle when L1 is released.

279f78158203109a.name: run_gun_attack
279f78158203109a.doc: State 800: plays the gun attack motion and returns to state 0 when it ends, calling reset_attack_presses(6) between 30 and 40 percent of the motion (where Max's working script fires the gun from slot 6). Under this disc's numbering the state reads and writes do nothing.

27c57330cc5d2563.name: on_update
27c57330cc5d2563.doc: Main loop of the form. The confirm button starts a melee attack (state 100) and the square button casts the elemental bolt (state 200), both turning toward the target first; the state lives in the saved value.

28f01b5098f933c2.name: perform_mid_range_attack
28f01b5098f933c2.doc: State machine keyed on the saved value 200: plays the mid-range attack motion, lunges forward during the middle of the swing and clears the saved value when the motion ends.

2b8b1272b6cba3c5.name: on_update
2b8b1272b6cba3c5.doc: Player-controlled loop: Confirm starts the attack 1 state (100) and Square starts the sticky attack state (200), both turning toward the target first. Otherwise the stick moves the character.

2cd947cb27e798de.name: land_and_stand
2cd947cb27e798de.doc: Releases anything held and returns to the battle stand motion after landing.

3057469d5f044961.name: run_charge_attack
3057469d5f044961.doc: When the action state is 100 plays the charge motion (suicide charge) and waits briefly once it has completed. Decompiled with several unresolved engine calls, so details are approximate.

34e0f0527ab85b24.name: reset_guard_and_held_item
34e0f0527ab85b24.doc: Drops the guard, releases and throws any held item. Run when the character is reset.

361b0ceaa9e816ec.name: update_player_action_state
361b0ceaa9e816ec.doc: Main loop of Max's action script. It dispatches the current action state (combo 100, lunge 200, knockdown kick 300, gun 800, guard 900, item throw 1000, lift 1100, charge 1200, backflip 1300), and in state 0 picks a new one from the buttons and target distance.

364ce8b49102180a.name: kick_and_grab
364ce8b49102180a.doc: State 1000 plays the kick motion on the legs and, once past 35 percent, picks up a map stone within 40 units of the right foot (keri_R) and moves to state 1001, which returns to idle when the kick motion ends.

36a844aa2f8aac0f.name: on_reset
36a844aa2f8aac0f.doc: Deletes the charge effect if there is one and releases anything held.

37299c2287fb4e8a.name: register_dodge_attack_hit
37299c2287fb4e8a.doc: Registers the monster sword hit of the dodge attack and sets the move speed to 3.2.

37c4348dce2e6b11.name: play_death_and_wait_for_confirm
37c4348dce2e6b11.doc: Plays the player's death motion, then waits until the confirm button is pressed before clearing the saved value.

38a49d7aa9ad03ec.name: on_land
38a49d7aa9ad03ec.doc: Cancels guard and the charge effect, releases anything held, and returns to the battle stand.

38ebdf0d5c983f53.name: run_player_control_loop
38ebdf0d5c983f53.doc: Main loop while the player controls this form. Stick moves it; the confirm button starts the sword attack (saved value 100) and the square button starts the pumpkin bomb throw (saved value 200), both turning toward the target first.

3982019dde15a637.name: wait_motion_end
3982019dde15a637.doc: Waits frame by frame until the actor's motion is done, then returns 1.

39d0dc70256c3dc6.name: fall_from_knockdown
39d0dc70256c3dc6.doc: Meant to knock the character back harder than the damage reaction (speed 8.0 instead of 5.0), drop what it holds, play the damage motion, wait 8 frames and return to idle. Under this disc's numbering the knockback, drop and motion calls run other natives and the state reset does nothing.

3d353da7afd3770e.name: run_player_attack_loop
3d353da7afd3770e.doc: Player-controlled loop for this form: stick moves the character, the confirm button starts the spin combo (saved value 100) and the square button starts the sticky attack (200). While an attack state is active it turns toward the target and runs that attack.

3e4bd24bd9fdf6f0.name: update_sword_combo_model_0
3e4bd24bd9fdf6f0.doc: Runs the five-hit sword combo state machine (saved value 100 to 105) for weapon model 0: moves the character during each swing, chains the next hit on a button press in its window, takes a held button to the charge attack (1200), and goes to the third hit when the stick points at the target.

3e6f037a254cd5fc.name: run_lift_and_throw
3e6f037a254cd5fc.doc: States 1100 to 1103: pick up the object in front of Max, carry it, and throw it on confirm. The grab is attempted in a window of the lift motion and gives 10 frames of invincibility.

3f827555d4881020.name: shoot_venom_attack
3f827555d4881020.doc: Plays attack 2 and spawns the venom projectile effect from the dcol02 point, facing the character's rotation and carrying the main weapon's attack power. Resets the saved action value to 0 afterwards.

42096e93c8e74c8d.name: throw_pumpkin_bomb
42096e93c8e74c8d.doc: Plays the second attack motion and spawns the pumpkin bomb effect at the kabo frame when the motion reaches 64-68%. The effect's damage value is the equipped main weapon's attack.

48b7f220052b0cf7.name: control_monster_by_pad
48b7f220052b0cf7.doc: Main loop for the monster the player controls: stick moves it, confirm starts the normal attack (saved value 100) and square starts the petrify shot (saved value 200).

4aa737afd0e301a2.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
4aa737afd0e301a2.doc: Heavy hit: long knockback, plays the knocked-flying motion then the get-up motion, then clears the saved state value.

4b9ca907464d41c8.name: on_update
4b9ca907464d41c8.doc: Main control loop for Monica. The action state in the saved value selects the running action: 100 sword combo, 200 mid-range attack, 300 knockdown strike, 800 magic, 900 guard and throw, 1000 item throw, 1100 lift and throw, 1200 charge attack, 1300 back flip. In idle it reads the buttons: Confirm attacks (or back flips on the back key), R1 guards, L1 charges magic, Square uses the active item.

4c9a528dbb83001e.name: delete_effect_if_set
4c9a528dbb83001e.doc: Deletes the effect whose handle is stored in global charge_effect, unless charge_effect is -1.

4ce2d426e842604a.name: setup_transformed_attack_hits
4ce2d426e842604a.doc: Registers the dcol00 attack collision with the monster attack hit and a 5.0 radius body collision on bcol00.

509d72cc0b18fa99.name: wait_frames
509d72cc0b18fa99.doc: Waits the given number of frames.

51416c1cd676ea0c.name: run_guard_catch_and_throw
51416c1cd676ea0c.doc: States 900 to 904: raise the guard with R1, catch what is in front with the action button, carry it, then throw it on confirm. The catch gives 10 frames of invincibility, and the held object is released partway through the throw motion.

535fc6dd2b1a6ee2.name: update_item_throw
535fc6dd2b1a6ee2.doc: Item throw state machine for saved values 1000 and 1001: plays the throw item motion, throws the held item at 45 to 50 percent of the motion, then clears the saved value when the motion ends.

54b75a109bcb708f.name: play_death_and_clear_state
54b75a109bcb708f.doc: Drops the guard, releases anything held, plays the death motion and clears the saved action value.

590b13a354633ead.name: setup_monster_attacks
590b13a354633ead.doc: Registers the two monster attack hit areas (dcol00 and dcol01) for attack 1 and attack 2.

593daae045211d11.name: control_monster_by_pad
593daae045211d11.doc: Main loop for the monster the player controls: stick moves it, the confirm button starts attack 1 (saved value 100) and the square button starts attack 2 (saved value 200), each turning toward the target first.

5a1c8a48894c10db.name: run_guard_and_throw
5a1c8a48894c10db.doc: Guard state (900 and up): guard in, hold R1 to keep guarding, Confirm to lift and grab a nearby enemy or object with the throw motion, carry it and throw it. L1 with R1 plays a sword swing that fires sword magic.

5a5789cb173e265b.name: update_single_shot_gun
5a5789cb173e265b.doc: Gun state machine for saved values 800 and 801: aims while L1 is held, and while the attack button is also held plays the fire motion, firing one sub-weapon shot early in it, then returns to aiming and fires again if the buttons are still held. Releasing L1 ends it.

5a5d2ef34aedaa2b.name: run_mid_range_attack
5a5d2ef34aedaa2b.doc: States 200 and 201: plays the mid-range attack, pushes Max forward between 30 and 40 percent of the motion, and returns to state 0 after 6 frames once it ends. Under this disc's numbering the state reads, state writes and the push are _EXT_ calls that do nothing.

5b4c11e9e1597259.name: fire_weapon_short_burst
5b4c11e9e1597259.doc: Ridepod ranged weapon burst (states 100 to 110) with the menu blocked and stick movement still running on the body: plays the attack 1 in motion on the arm, then fires the weapon once per frame for 15 frames with the attack 1 r motion, plays the out motion and returns to state 0 when it ends. The long burst fires for 30 frames.

5cb35f82b3df3992.name: on_blocked
5cb35f82b3df3992.doc: Cancels the current action when an attack is blocked.

5d6e406b73031220.name: play_death_and_wait_for_confirm
5d6e406b73031220.doc: Releases anything held, plays the death motion and waits for the confirm button before clearing the action state.

628aaa4d5b6a4b73.name: run_knockdown_action
628aaa4d5b6a4b73.doc: Knockdown program shared by many playable characters; it only calls the knocked-flying and get-up sequence.

64fd3359042ee83b.name: setup_attack_hits
64fd3359042ee83b.doc: Assigns the model object slots, registers the normal and dodge attack hit areas and adds two body collisions.

663f862319c90be4.name: on_init
663f862319c90be4.doc: Registers the two monster attack hit areas dcol00 and dcol01 for the first attack animation.

66a05971e5f048f1.name: run_sword_combo_weapon_0
66a05971e5f048f1.doc: Sword combo state machine for sword model 0. Five-hit combo with hits 1 to 5 plus the knock-away finisher, using this weapon's own movement impulses and chain windows. Holding attack for over 10 frames in the first hit starts the charge attack (state 1200).

67144ffd6b828cd5.name: update_lift_and_throw
67144ffd6b828cd5.doc: State machine for saved values 1100 to 1103: lifts an enemy or item in front, carries it, and throws it on the confirm button.

686bda59daa0e509.name: setup_attack_hits
686bda59daa0e509.doc: Registers the two monster attack hit windows with sword trails and sets the movement speed of this player-controlled monster form.

68c917ab07401583.name: run_lift_and_throw
68c917ab07401583.doc: Handles lift and throw, states 1100 to 1103, entered by the guard and attack buttons together or by an active item. It grabs a nearby object and throws it on confirm.

6f73c267fac5dfd0.name: on_stopped
6f73c267fac5dfd0.doc: Knocks Monica back and holds the damage pose until the stun status flags clear, then returns to idle.

72266dffdc40393f.name: run_magic_aim_state
72266dffdc40393f.doc: Handles magic aiming while L1 is held (states 800, 801): aims, keeps the charge effect on her item frame, and on confirm plays the cast and fires the spell01 sub weapon. Releasing L1 cancels and removes the charge effect.

7232918761830abb.name: register_monster_sword_hits
7232918761830abb.doc: Registers the sword hit boxes and sword trails for each attack of monster forms 176, 177, 180, 183, 186 and 187. The hit windows and bone pairs differ per form.

752c21ba54711af0.name: update_slow_shot_gun
752c21ba54711af0.doc: Gun state machine for saved values 840 and 841: like the single shot gun but with a 6-frame pause after each shot.

77ad475bf19eba31.name: play_charge_attack
77ad475bf19eba31.doc: Attack 2 state machine driven by the saved value (200 to 203): plays the wind-up motion, loops the attack motion for 45 frames, then gives a forward move impulse and plays the wind-down, clearing the state at the end.

77d4cfc0988a2d06.name: react_to_blocked_hit
77d4cfc0988a2d06.doc: Meant to knock Max back after a blocked hit, then waits 10 frames and resets the state to 0. Under this disc's numbering the knockback runs play_chara_se with a bad bank, so nothing plays, it calls fire_sword_magic(0.0), and the state reset is an _EXT_ call that does nothing.

783837eeeffdc7ba.name: update_guard_lift_and_throw
783837eeeffdc7ba.doc: Handles states 900 to 904: guard with R1, lift a nearby object or enemy with confirm, carry it and throw it. Holding L1 and R1 together also fires sword magic.

789c8826acecc440.name: on_update
789c8826acecc440.doc: Player-controlled loop for this transformed form: the confirm button starts the normal attack (saved value 100) and the square button the venom shot (saved value 200). Otherwise the stick moves the character.

78bc4bccf1c456f9.name: shoot_petrify_ball
78bc4bccf1c456f9.doc: Attack 2: at the middle of the motion it spawns a looping petrify shot from the dcol02 point, passing the weapon's attack power as damage.

790450db7c8da38e.name: setup_sword_attacks_and_sounds
790450db7c8da38e.doc: Registers Max's sword attack hit boxes, blade trails, body collisions, charge effect slot, gun and wrench footstep and attack sounds. Runs once when the action script loads.

795e4f16fcf82ba0.name: on_blocked
795e4f16fcf82ba0.doc: Cancels guard and plays the after-guard motion until it finishes.

7f2b0b02549459d9.name: run_sword_combo_weapon_3
7f2b0b02549459d9.doc: Sword combo state machine for sword model 3. Five-hit combo plus knock-away finisher with a long slide forward, using this weapon's own movement impulses and chain windows. Holding attack for over 10 frames in the first hit starts the charge attack (state 1200).

804bb3132cce5efc.name: shoot_curse_bolt
804bb3132cce5efc.doc: Plays the attack loop motion, waits 20 frames and launches a curse shot effect from the magic_coll point, carrying the weapon attack value as its damage.

81bdbc2c5cf3e331.name: launch_sticky_blob_attack
81bdbc2c5cf3e331.doc: Plays attack 2 and at the right motion frame spawns the sticky effect at the dcol1 point, facing the character's rotation, with the main weapon attack value as its damage. Resets the action state when the motion ends.

8226ecc5ef0cddf4.name: run_shooter_control_loop
8226ecc5ef0cddf4.doc: Per-frame loop for the controllable monster form: stick movement, and on the confirm button it turns toward the target and fires a shot.

8442a3d20f4f0af4.name: play_death_motion
8442a3d20f4f0af4.doc: Drops what Max is holding and plays the death motion.

85ecb9a102d730a0.name: play_damage_reaction
85ecb9a102d730a0.doc: Reaction to taking damage: turns off the charge effect, knocks the character back, releases any held object, plays the after-damage motion for 8 frames and clears the saved action value.

864f74ca60539c59.name: run_player_action_loop
864f74ca60539c59.doc: Main loop. When idle the stick moves the character, the confirm button starts the gun shot (state 100) and square starts the dodge attack (state 200). Both states turn toward the target while they run.

883bd03bc8c68b79.name: recoil_until_stop_ends
883bd03bc8c68b79.doc: Drops the guard, releases anything held and plays the damage motion with a knockback until the stop status flags clear. Clears the saved action value and allows the menu meanwhile.

89a426876720ea25.name: on_damage
89a426876720ea25.doc: Drops guard and cancels the current action when damaged.

89a96ab5aa0f4294.name: set_move_speed_on_init
89a96ab5aa0f4294.doc: Sets the movement speed of this monster form to 3.4.

8cf75b04808466fd.name: fire_weapon_while_held
8cf75b04808466fd.doc: Fires the ridepod weapon every third frame for as long as the action button is held, then returns to idle.

8e2dadd21feb92d3.name: release_held_on_reset
8e2dadd21feb92d3.doc: Drops whatever Max is holding when the action script is reset.

8e4928e597338616.name: update_magic_aim_and_cast
8e4928e597338616.doc: Handles Monica's magic states 800 and 801. While L1 is held she aims with the charge effect kept on her item frame, and the spell power grows from 0.8 by 0.5 per second up to 1.3; releasing L1 cancels and removes the effect. Pressing confirm plays the cast, which fires spell01 scaled by that power at 25 to 30 percent of the motion; L1 and confirm after 65 percent restart the cast, and when it ends she returns to aiming with a new charge effect.

91f052592e6c99dd.name: play_sword_knockdown
91f052592e6c99dd.doc: State machine keyed on the saved value 300: plays the sword knockdown motion, then clears the saved value and waits 3 frames.

930945d379277323.name: shoot_fox_bullet
930945d379277323.doc: State 100 to 101: plays the aim-in motion, then fires a fox bullet effect from the dcol00 bone with the main weapon's attack power plus a muzzle flash, and plays the recovery motion with a sound.

94d88916229fb831.name: play_dodge_attack
94d88916229fb831.doc: Plays the dodge attack motion when the stored action value is 200, pushing the body forward between 1% and 30% of the motion and clearing the action value when the motion ends. Returns 0.

9df4a28d39cfe408.name: on_knockdown
9df4a28d39cfe408.doc: Knocks the ridepod back, faces the source of the blow, plays the standing motion for its leg or caterpillar type, and cancels the current action.

9e5dd9d1f865322f.name: hold_guard_recoil_pose
9e5dd9d1f865322f.doc: Deletes the charge effect if one is set, stops any knockback movement and holds the after-guard motion until it finishes.

9f470adf2fe6496a.name: on_update
9f470adf2fe6496a.doc: Per-frame loop for this controllable actor: confirm plays a melee attack and square shoots a curse bolt.

a276d8f3776c9e86.name: play_knocked_flying_reaction
a276d8f3776c9e86.doc: Knocks the character back, faces the blow source, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then clears the saved action value.

a53a67fe10411b09.name: run_death_action
a53a67fe10411b09.doc: Death program shared by many playable characters; it only calls the death motion sequence that waits for the confirm button.

a5c3d0e69504c46f.name: init_double_hit_monster
a5c3d0e69504c46f.doc: Registers two monster attack hit volumes (dcol0, dcol1) for attack 1.

a7bdeea6287091eb.name: play_first_attack
a7bdeea6287091eb.doc: While the action state is 100, plays attack 1 once with a forward step and returns the state to 0 when the motion ends.

a7fa3b4196cd9c5e.name: update_attack_actions
a7fa3b4196cd9c5e.doc: Per-frame update program: moves with the stick when idle, starts action 100 (plain attack) on the confirm button or action 200 (second attack) on the square button, and while an action is active turns toward the target and runs it.

ab0825d81d0675e0.name: run_guard_and_catch_throw
ab0825d81d0675e0.doc: Handles guard, catch and throw, states 900 to 904. Holding the guard button guards, pressing attack during guard starts the lift to grab something, and confirm throws what is held.

ac1b692337452fce.name: wait_motion_end_old_numbered
ac1b692337452fce.doc: Old-numbered copy of wait_motion_end, meant to wait frame by frame until the motion is done and then return 1. Under this disc's numbering the check runs fire_sub_weapon with the flag's address as its slot, which never writes the flag, so the wait does not track the motion.

ac3c9899baa197ca.name: recoil_from_light_hit
ac3c9899baa197ca.doc: Light knockback: short push, releases anything held, plays the damage motion and clears the saved state value.

ac79d9e18d1f4ca9.name: run_sword_combo
ac79d9e18d1f4ca9.doc: Handles the five hit sword combo, states 100 to 104. Pressing attack inside each hit's timing window chains into the next hit, holding attack for over 12 frames jumps to the charge attack (1200), and the state returns to 0 when the motion ends.

ae6e38decb2cc993.name: play_light_damage_reaction
ae6e38decb2cc993.doc: Short knockback and damage motion for a light hit. Releases anything held and clears the saved action value.

aeecd480af06f083.name: fire_elemental_shot
aeecd480af06f083.doc: Plays the attack motion and launches a ranged elemental shot (fire, ice, thunder, wind or holy, chosen by monster form 112/116/120/124/128) from the dcol0 point. Shot damage is the main weapon attack.

b0e87d2733c76c0c.name: play_guard_recovery_motion
b0e87d2733c76c0c.doc: Stops movement and plays the after-guard motion, then waits until that motion finishes.

b1655ccf42760743.name: hold_guard
b1655ccf42760743.doc: Plays the guard motion and keeps guarding while R1 is held; releases guard and returns to idle when it is let go.

b3185b4b907f68ac.name: run_charge_attack_states
b3185b4b907f68ac.doc: State machine for the charged attack (states 1000 to 1002): holds the charge loop until the button has been held for more than 30 frames, then releases the charge attack motion and waits for it to end. Releasing early cancels back to state 0.

b374bd5ee4f3a421.name: update_sword_combo_model_2
b374bd5ee4f3a421.doc: Runs the five-hit sword combo state machine (saved value 100 to 105) for weapon model 2: moves the character during each swing, chains the next hit on a button press in its window, takes a held button to the charge attack (1200), and goes to the third hit when the stick points at the target.

b53113356d77f824.name: update_guard_catch_throw
b53113356d77f824.doc: State machine for saved values 900 to 904: raises the guard while R1 is held, catches an enemy or item when the grab button is pressed, carries it, and throws it on the confirm button.

b6bb8f3cfe8a131b.name: play_backflip_dodge
b6bb8f3cfe8a131b.doc: Plays the backflip dodge motion, pushing Max backward (angle 180) between 18 and 80 percent of it, then waits 6 frames after it ends and resets the state to 0. Under this disc's numbering the push and the state reset are _EXT_ calls that do nothing.

b7d4db74fc6790b4.name: wait_motion_in_range
b7d4db74fc6790b4.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion progress is between start_time and end_time. Returns 0.

b8a015fe2652faa8.name: play_attack_once
b8a015fe2652faa8.doc: When the saved value is 100, plays the first attack motion once and resets the saved value to 0 when the motion status reaches 4. Returns 0 only on that path.

bd513f84e995bd9e.name: run_magic_aim_and_cast
bd513f84e995bd9e.doc: Magic state (800): while L1 is held, aims with the magic motion, moves the charge effect to the item point and grows the charge level up to 1.3. Confirm casts, firing the spell sub weapon at progress 0.25 with the charge level; releasing L1 cancels.

bfa450f60cfc7433.name: init_sword_monster
bfa450f60cfc7433.doc: Registers the monster sword hit volumes (dcol0, dcol1) for attack 1 and sets the move speed to 2.8.

c2174c3dae861ffe.name: on_init
c2174c3dae861ffe.doc: Reads the equipped sword model, registers hit boxes and blade trails for each of Monica's sword attacks (they differ per weapon model 0 to 3), the charge attack and the mid-range attack, and sets up the object slots.

c254ceba50f8350d.name: run_second_attack_action
c254ceba50f8350d.doc: Action state 200: plays the second attack motion once, and clears the saved value when the motion status reaches 4 so the update loop returns to idle.

c3a0349698c1df01.name: run_sword_combo
c3a0349698c1df01.doc: Runs the five-hit sword combo while the action state is 100 to 105. Each hit pushes Max forward during parts of its motion, and an attack press in the next hit's window plays the next hit, or the third-hit kick (state 105) when the stick points at the target during the second hit. During the first hit only, holding the attack button for more than 12 frames switches to the charge attack (state 1200).

c50cc098f2953c59.name: register_sword_attack_hit
c50cc098f2953c59.doc: Registers the monster sword hit area (dcol0 to dcol1) used by the first attack.

c59fe33f3a487126.name: on_death
c59fe33f3a487126.doc: Drops any held object, plays the death motion and waits for the confirm button before clearing the state.

c5a437119d50693b.name: on_death
c5a437119d50693b.doc: Cancels guard and the charge effect, releases anything held and plays the death motion.

c7715823b8d02c99.name: setup_attack_hit
c7715823b8d02c99.doc: Registers the sword hit window for attack 1.

c7fe6c71abf32fbb.name: dodge_backflip
c7fe6c71abf32fbb.doc: Plays the backflip dodge motion with 20 frames of invincibility, pushing backward during the middle of the animation, then clears the saved value.

c9c45d3872991f52.name: run_three_hit_combo
c9c45d3872991f52.doc: Right punch, then left punch, then two-handed punch; another attack press inside each motion window chains to the next hit. Windows are fractions of motion progress and differ per attack type.

cd8a5b2490eba82a.name: run_action_loop
cd8a5b2490eba82a.doc: Main loop. Runs the return handler for states 100 to 198, and in state 0 runs the carry movement and, when the pad bits read each frame have bit 32 set (the input f204a.c treats as confirm), plays the victory pose and enters state 100. Under this disc's numbering the state reads and writes are _EXT_ calls that do nothing.

cd9abac0ac8c4a04.name: run_lift_and_throw_state
cd9abac0ac8c4a04.doc: Handles lifting and throwing an object (states 1100 to 1103) when R1 and confirm are pressed together or a lift item is used. Carries the object until confirm throws it.

ce3cc6abe5f1614b.name: on_init
ce3cc6abe5f1614b.doc: Registers the monster attack hit box on dcol0 for attack 1.

cec1b664037483d9.name: update_player_controlled_monster
cec1b664037483d9.doc: Per-frame loop for the monster while the player controls it: the confirm button starts attack 1 (state 100), and stick input moves it while idle. States 100 to 198 turn toward the target and attack.

cedfb7f29ea5d643.name: on_init
cedfb7f29ea5d643.doc: Registers Monica's sword attack hit boxes, body collisions, blade trails and motion sounds, and clears the charge effect handle.

cf85a1fef7b684e6.name: on_update
cf85a1fef7b684e6.doc: Per-frame state machine: dispatches the running action by state number ranges (100 sword combo, 200 mid-range, 300 knockdown strike, 800 magic, 900 guard, 1000 item throw, 1100 lift, 1200 charge, 1300 back flip), and when idle picks the next action from the pressed buttons and target distance.

d28fdb4689d17250.name: on_reset
d28fdb4689d17250.doc: Cancels guard and the charge effect and releases anything held.

d2aa39424684026b.name: run_sword_combo_weapon_1
d2aa39424684026b.doc: Sword combo state machine for sword model 1. Four-hit combo (states 100 to 103) with this weapon's own movement impulses and chain windows; pressing attack in the second hit's window with the stick toward the target plays the knock-away finisher (state 105) instead of the third hit. Holding attack for over 10 frames in the first hit starts the charge attack (state 1200).

d340a2d7f1b0a2cd.name: react_to_damage
d340a2d7f1b0a2cd.doc: Meant to knock Max back (speed 5.0), drop what he holds, play the damage motion, wait 8 frames and reset the state to 0. Under this disc's numbering the knockback runs play_chara_se with a bad bank, so nothing plays, the drop and motion calls run other natives, and the state reset is an _EXT_ call that does nothing.

d38862475dbe7d97.name: run_player_action_loop
d38862475dbe7d97.doc: Main loop for Max's actions. The saved value picks the state: 100 sword combo, 200 lunge, 300 knockdown strike, 800 gun, 900 guard and throw, 1000 item throw, 1100 lift and throw, 1200 charge attack, 1300 backflip. From idle it chooses the next state from the buttons, the stick direction and the target's distance and status.

d3dadbc2dca6aac4.name: run_attack_and_move_loop
d3dadbc2dca6aac4.doc: Main loop of a player action script. While the saved value is 100 to 198 it turns toward the target and plays the attack; at 0 it handles stick movement and starts the attack (value 100) when the action button is confirmed.

d4b47b71a33abea6.name: cast_elemental_bolt
d4b47b71a33abea6.doc: Plays the second attack motion and spawns a fire, wind, ice or thunder bolt effect chosen by the monster form (44 to 47). The bolt starts at the col_magic point, flies along the facing, and carries the main weapon's attack value as damage.

d938254a58f8b5a5.name: on_knockdown
d938254a58f8b5a5.doc: Cancels guard, knocks the character far back facing the blow, plays knocked flying and get up, and clears the action state.

d99da6b12fbf1369.name: return_from_victory_pose
d99da6b12fbf1369.doc: State 100: when the motion ends, plays the return motion and resets the state to 0.

da1d83ea09280bc9.name: run_sword_combo_weapon_2
da1d83ea09280bc9.doc: Sword combo state machine for sword model 2. Six-hit combo plus knock-away finisher, using this weapon's own movement impulses and chain windows. Holding attack for over 10 frames in the first hit starts the charge attack (state 1200).

dbca75cd1674256d.name: run_kick_attack
dbca75cd1674256d.doc: States 300 and 301: plays the knockdown kick motion and returns to state 0 when it ends.

dc2d31d63fa3a9d5.name: react_to_knockdown
dc2d31d63fa3a9d5.doc: Meant to knock Max back, drop what he holds, play the knocked-flying motion until it ends, wait 8 frames, play the get-up motion until it ends, wait 2 frames and reset the state to 0. Under this disc's numbering the knockback, drop, motion and end checks run other natives, and the state reset is an _EXT_ call that does nothing.

dd178a87b47fd5b2.name: setup_wrench_and_gun_actions
dd178a87b47fd5b2.doc: Meant to register Max's object slots, attack hits for the triple wrench combo, mid-range attack, knockdown kick, charge attack and lift, two body collisions, sword trails, the charge effect slot and footstep and attack sounds. Under this disc's numbering the calls run other natives (colour flashes, camera shakes, equipment and pad queries), and the sound registrations are _EXT_ calls that do nothing.

de1482560a622c06.name: update_player_controlled_monster
de1482560a622c06.doc: Per-frame loop while the player controls the monster: confirm starts attack 1 (state 100), square starts the explosion action (state 200), and stick input moves it while idle.

e1cbb4bb87e41a7d.name: run_spin_attack_combo
e1cbb4bb87e41a7d.doc: Steps through the three-part spin attack, driven by the saved value: 100 plays the wind-up and creates the Himara spin attack effect with the main weapon's attack, 101 the spin, 102 the recovery and then resets the saved value to 0.

e1f9d01a18b36912.name: play_second_attack
e1f9d01a18b36912.doc: Two-stage attack 2: plays the wind-up motion, then the strike once the first motion has finished. The saved value 200 and 201 track which stage is running and it resets to 0 at the end.

e277e2d728c06269.name: register_max_attacks_and_sounds
e277e2d728c06269.doc: Registers Max's collision slots, sword and kick attack hits for each combo step, the charge attack, blade trails, and footstep and attack sound effects for the Max action script.

e3945a707bc42219.name: on_init
e3945a707bc42219.doc: Registers hit boxes (and sword trails for type 20) for the ridepod's right, left and two-handed attacks according to its attack type, and picks the standing motion for legs or caterpillar movement.

e41c4ce8940881d0.name: run_guard_and_throw_state
e41c4ce8940881d0.doc: Handles guarding with R1 (states 900 to 904): guard loop, pressing confirm lifts a nearby object, carries it, and confirm again throws it.

e49d7278fcf95d16.name: setup_charge_attack_hits
e49d7278fcf95d16.doc: Meant to register the Kotore's object slots 0 and 2, an attack hit for the suicide charge motion and a body collision. Under this disc's numbering the calls run other natives instead (colour flashes, a camera shake and an equipment query), so nothing is registered.

e6662865e2603316.name: recover_after_block
e6662865e2603316.doc: Meant to knock the character back after a blocked hit, then waits 10 frames and returns to idle. Under this disc's numbering the knockback runs play_chara_se with a bad bank, so nothing plays, it calls fire_sword_magic(0.0), and the state reset is an _EXT_ call that does nothing.

e89cd82d1961b2d6.name: on_update
e89cd82d1961b2d6.doc: Main per-frame loop for Monica. Reads the pad and picks the next action state (sword combo, mid-range attack, back flip, charge attack, magic, guard, throw, item) and dispatches to the matching state function.

ea530fb5e69277b5.name: fire_alternating_arm_weapons
ea530fb5e69277b5.doc: Fires the ridepod weapon mid-motion, using the right arm and then the left arm on alternate attacks (tracked in the first global).

ec1e06165f43deea.name: setup_max_attacks
ec1e06165f43deea.doc: Reads the equipped weapon model, names the attack collision slots and registers the hit windows and blade trails of the five-hit sword combo, third hit, mid-range attack, charge attack and knockdown kick, with timings that depend on the weapon model.

ecc8b197dcd12226.name: on_death
ecc8b197dcd12226.doc: Clears any charge effect, drops whatever is held and plays the death motion.

eda8f859120cfd17.name: update_sword_combo
eda8f859120cfd17.doc: Runs the five-hit sword combo for Monica (states 100 to 104). Each hit pushes her forward during part of its motion (the third also drifts her back at its end), and pressing attack inside the hit's input window starts the next swing. During the first swing only, holding attack for more than 10 frames moves to the charge attack (state 1200).

ee1f31ec63f68dfe.name: on_update
ee1f31ec63f68dfe.doc: Player-controlled ridepod loop. Confirm starts a grab-kick (legged types) or the attack chain for the equipped attack type, R1 starts guarding for melee types, and each active state is run by its handler.

ee6262fbd37f6d33.name: on_init
ee6262fbd37f6d33.doc: Registers the single monster attack hit window for this actor.

ef0b900f09a413d2.name: run_attack_input_loop
ef0b900f09a413d2.doc: Main loop. Confirm starts a normal attack (value 100), square starts the dodge attack (value 200); while an attack value is set it turns toward the target and plays the matching attack, otherwise the stick moves the character.

f3ecdc6a51d34bff.name: update_machine_gun
f3ecdc6a51d34bff.doc: Gun state machine for saved values 820 and 821: while fire and aim are held, fires a sub-weapon shot every third frame.

f5854ea09a5c2518.name: update_sword_combo_model_1
f5854ea09a5c2518.doc: Runs the sword combo state machine for weapon model 1, a four-hit combo (saved values 100 to 103) with camera shakes on the first and fourth hits: moves the character during each swing, chains the next hit on a button press in its window, takes a held button in the first hit to the charge attack (1200), and in the second hit goes to the third-hit finisher (105) instead when the stick points at the target.

f61318255de8e33f.name: explode_at_full_hp
f61318255de8e33f.doc: Spawns the explosion effect at the monster and drops its HP to 5% of maximum, but only at full HP: get_hp_rate divides in integers, so the 0.5 check passes only when HP is full. Otherwise it just clears the state. Returns 0.

f965f5ec5e8cc5ea.name: recover_from_stagger
f965f5ec5e8cc5ea.doc: Runs when Max is frozen by the stop status. Knocks him back, drops what he holds, and holds the damage motion until the stop status bits (8 and 32) clear, letting the menu be opened meanwhile. Then returns to idle.

fc257ec83ba959b7.name: cancel_guard_and_charge_effect
fc257ec83ba959b7.doc: Turns guarding off and deletes the magic charge effect if one exists.

fd8b8084f41b7749.name: update_lift_and_throw
fd8b8084f41b7749.doc: Handles states 1100 to 1103: lift the thing in front of Monica, carry it, and throw it with confirm. Falls back to idle if nothing was grabbed.

fe5c6e150d29b48a.name: shoot_sticky_attack
fe5c6e150d29b48a.doc: Plays attack 2 and, partway through the motion, creates the looping sticky effect at the dcol01 object facing the character's rotation. Resets the saved value to 0 when the motion ends.
